candidates.evidence: long_name='Average Surface Skin temperature'; standard_name='surface_temperature'; units='K'; name suffix '_inst'; global attribute 'inst definision: instantaneous'; cell_methods='time: mean'
candidates.notes: File name suffix is '_inst', but cell_methods='time: mean': the monthly field is a monthly mean of instantaneous skin temperature. This is surface skin temperature, not near-surface air temperature.

candidates.evidence: long_name='Root zone soil moisture'; standard_name='root_zone_soil_moisture'; units='kg m-2'; name suffix '_inst'; global attribute 'inst definision: instantaneous'; cell_methods='time: mean'

sanity_checks.description: negative values in a physically non-negative quantity

candidates.notes: Root-zone soil moisture is a Noah model diagnostic, not a direct in-situ measurement. Units are kg m-2 (water equivalent).

candidates.evidence: long_name='Temperature'; standard_name='air_temperature'; units='K'; name suffix '_inst'; global attribute 'inst definision: instantaneous'; cell_methods='time: mean'
candidates.notes: Model forcing field (air temperature at the lowest model level). Label it as a forcing field in user-facing text.

candidates.evidence: long_name='Soil moisture'; standard_name='soil_moisture_content'; units='kg m-2'; name suffix '_inst'; global attribute 'inst definision: instantaneous'; cell_methods='time: mean'

sanity_checks.description: negative values in a physically non-negative quantity

candidates.notes: Top soil layer 0-10 cm. Units are kg m-2 (water equivalent).

candidates.evidence: long_name='Evapotranspiration'; standard_name='water_evaporation_flux'; units='kg m-2 s-1'; name suffix '_tavg'; global attribute 'tavg definision: past 3-hour average'; cell_methods='time: mean'
candidates.monthly_statistic: mean over the month of 3-hourly averages (cell_methods='time: mean')

sanity_checks.description: no hard physical-range check defined for this quantity

candidates.notes: Rate in kg m-2 s-1; the monthly field is a time mean of 3-hourly averages. Small negative valid values occur (condensation) and are not flagged as impossible.

candidates.evidence: long_name='Storm surface runoff'; standard_name='surface_runoff_amount'; units='kg m-2'; name suffix '_acc'; global attribute 'acc definision: past 3-hour accumulation'; cell_methods='time: mean'
candidates.monthly_statistic: unknown (file gives an 'acc' definition but time: mean)

sanity_checks.description: negative values in a physically non-negative quantity

candidates.notes: Accumulation units (kg m-2). The file defines 'acc' as a past 3-hour accumulation, yet cell_methods='time: mean'. The file does NOT state whether the monthly value is a monthly total or a monthly mean of 3-hour accumulations; monthly_statistic is therefore 'unknown' and must be resolved in P02 before any totals are computed.

candidates.evidence: long_name='Snow depth water equivalent'; standard_name='surface_snow_amount'; units='kg m-2'; name suffix '_inst'; global attribute 'inst definision: instantaneous'; cell_methods='time: mean'

sanity_checks.description: negative values in a physically non-negative quantity

sanity_warnings: Extreme maximum SWE (above 50,000 kg m-2) concentrated near 60.875 N, 44.125 W (Greenland) in the samples. This is a broad plausibility warning, not a scientific conclusion; mask or quality-control SWE before analysis.
candidates.notes: State variable. Meaningful only where snow occurs; mask to snow-covered cells before analysis.

candidates.evidence: long_name='Specific humidity'; standard_name='specific_humidity'; units='kg kg-1'; name suffix '_inst'; global attribute 'inst definision: instantaneous'; cell_methods='time: mean'
candidates.notes: Model forcing field; specific humidity (kg kg-1), not relative humidity.

candidates.evidence: long_name='Merged microwave-infrared-gauge precipitation estimate'; units='mm/hr'; GridHeader BinMethod=ARITHMETIC_MEAN; FileHeader TimeInterval=MONTH
candidates.monthly_statistic: monthly mean rate (GridHeader BinMethod=ARITHMETIC_MEAN; FileHeader TimeInterval=MONTH)

companions.name: randomError
companions.long_name:
Root-mean-square error estimate for 
                        merged microwave-infrared-gauge precipitation

companions.name: gaugeRelativeWeighting
companions.long_name:
Relative weight of gauge observation in 
                        the merged microwave-infrared-gauge precipitation estimate

companions.name: probabilityLiquidPrecipitation
companions.long_name:
Probability of liquid precipitation;  estimated with
                        a diagnostic parameterization using ancillary data

candidates.notes: The file stores mm/hr: a rate, not a monthly total. GridHeader BinMethod=ARITHMETIC_MEAN and FileHeader TimeInterval=MONTH indicate a monthly mean rate. P02 must multiply by the number of hours in each calendar month to obtain mm/month. Companion fields are randomError (mm/hr), gaugeRelativeWeighting (percent), probabilityLiquidPrecipitation (percent) and precipitationQualityIndex (no units attribute).
